scope: Minimal pinned native feasibility spike. This is not a production benchmark and not an edge claim.

verified_capabilities.evidence: pure-Rust event-driven taker replay; 15 orders / 8 positions on the 240s capture; 307 orders / 154 positions on the archive day
one funding settlement at the chunk boundary; funding is now emitted on the primary tape with attributable epoch (see evidence/labd/NATIVE_FUNDING_RUN.json)
open position, timer and funding state survive clear_data() between chunks

blocked_capabilities.missing_hook: Nautilus exposes one shared Cache to strategies (Strategy::cache()); there is no separate immutable LocalView and no API that prevents native cache access. Strategy::handle_position_event also returns before PositionAdjusted callbacks.
blocked_capabilities.failing_case: The strategy can read exchange cache state and receives fill callbacks immediately; a two-world exchange-effect/delayed-local-delivery split cannot be constructed without forking.

blocked_capabilities.missing_hook: SimulatedExchange has no per-price queue-ahead model, no own-consumption liquidity budget and no L2 queue API.
blocked_capabilities.failing_case: F02 queue-ahead depletion and one-shared-level-budget cannot be executed on the pinned engine.

blocked_capabilities.missing_hook: A single shared cache and in-process callback path cannot prove a process-level research/evaluator split inside one engine.

resource_profile.b4_boundary: The runner currently materializes the whole event vector, so the 1.24M-event prototype already shows linear growth. The production B4 1M/10M/100M plateau and the <=1 MiB per million event final-decile slope are NOT certified here; they belong to TASK-19 and TASK-25.

test_evidence.conformance: evidence/conformance/FIXTURE_REPORT.json: 44/44 scenarios PASS, including F01 order causality, F08 funding boundary and F15 chunk/timestamp boundary
test_evidence.pin_verification: scripts/verify_native_pin.py: PASS (12/12 checks) at the pinned commit

decision: No backend change is adopted. The pinned engine remains the candidate with a scoped taker certificate; M4 queue/LocalView work stays disabled until a supported hook or an ADR-selected backend exists.
claims_not_made: L2 queue or passive fill fidelity
